SessionContext: fresh incognito load auto-creates POST /demo/session and stores in localStorage.jobos.session_id; catch block now logs via console.warn (visible in console output) instead of silently swallowing
Console during full Maya E2E: 0 'each child in a list should have a unique key prop' warnings, 0 React hook errors
critical_code_review_comments: Fixes look correct and minimal. Content-based keys (fact-{i}-{slice(0,24)}, criteria-{i}-{slice(0,24)}) still incorporate index — technically that alone would satisfy React, but the content slice adds stability across reorders. Fine.

SessionContext console.warn is appropriate for a demo app; in production the pattern of falling back to a new session on any 4xx/5xx could mask real backend outages — consider distinguishing 404 (stale id) from 5xx (backend down) to avoid silently churning sessions.

CustomerProfilePage: useMemo dependency is [ledger, audit] which are derived (data?.ledger || []) recomputed each render. That means the memo will still recompute every render because the array identities change. Not a bug (rules-of-hooks fix is correct), but the memoization provides no actual perf benefit unless you memoize with [data] or the underlying arrays directly. Minor code-quality note only.
seed_data_creation: None — each test used a fresh POST /demo/session
